strings.고키소(GOKISO)는 항공기 제트엔진 베어링을 만드는 일본 콘도 머신의: GOKISO is the bicycle hub and wheel brand of Kondo Machine, a Japanese maker of jet engine bearings. Super Climber and Climber hubs, SLP carbon wheels and hubs for Moulton, Brompton and Birdy, at Rubi Workshop in Seoul.

Hubs built on jet engine bearing technology. GOKISO, Nagoya, Japan.
strings.Ti-6Al-4V 티타늄 합금 덩어리를 깎아 만든 고키소의 플래그십 허브: GOKISO's flagship hub, machined from solid Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy. Elastic outer body and DIN P5 bearings. Rim brake and through axle disc versions.
strings.A7075-T73 초초두랄루민 바디와 티타늄 액슬의 경량 허브. 쓰루액슬: Lightweight hub with an A7075-T73 extra super duralumin body and titanium axle. Through axle disc and rim brake S-spec, matte color options.
strings.스포크 홀 주변을 집중 보강한 풀 카본 클린처 림에 고키소 허브를 조립한: Complete wheelset built on GOKISO hubs with full carbon clincher rims reinforced around every spoke hole. Wide 30mm x 45mm, UCI certified.
Bicycle hubs built on jet engine bearing technology.
strings.티타늄 합금 덩어리를 깎아 만든 고키소의 정수: The essence of GOKISO, machined from solid titanium alloy
strings.같은 구조, 더 가벼운 초초두랄루민 바디: The same structure in a lighter extra super duralumin body
strings.고키소 허브로 완성한 와이드 카본 휠셋: Wide carbon wheelsets completed with GOKISO hubs
strings.고키소(GOKISO)는 일본 아이치현의 초정밀 공작기계·금속 절삭 가공: GOKISO is a bicycle component brand launched in January 2010 by Kondo Machine, an ultra-precision machine tool and metal cutting company in Aichi, Japan. Founded in 1947, Kondo Machine makes jet engine bearings and ultra-precision dies, and its factory is certified to the JIS Q 9100 aerospace quality standard. GOKISO hubs and rims are machined in that same factory, to the same standard as aircraft parts.
strings.브랜드 이름은 나고야 고키소(御器所)에 있는 고키소 하치만 신사에서 가져: The name comes from Gokiso Hachiman Shrine in the Gokiso district of Nagoya, the neighbourhood where the company began. Instead of following trends, GOKISO set out to keep design, machining and quality control entirely in its own hands and put "truly good things" into the world. That is where the brand starts.
strings.1947년 창업, 제트엔진 베어링 제조사: Founded 1947, maker of jet engine bearings
strings.통 소재에서 깎아낸 탄성 바디: Elastic body machined from one solid piece
strings.허브 바디 바깥 둘레를 손가락 모양으로 깎아 낸 탄성 구조가 노면 충격과: An elastic structure machined into fingers around the outside of the hub body absorbs road shock and spoke tension. The flanges are separated from the bearing housing, so loads from the rim never reach the bearings directly.
strings.제트엔진 주축 베어링과 같은 생각입니다. 베어링은 변형 없이 똑바로 놓여: The same thinking as a jet engine main shaft bearing: a bearing only performs when it sits straight and undeformed. Spherical nuts and washers keep the axle straight even when the frame flexes.
strings.티타늄과 초초두랄루민 소재를 NC 절삭으로 한 덩어리에서 깎아 내고, 하: Titanium and extra super duralumin are NC-machined from a single block, then polished one by one by hand. A small factory makes them in small runs, so production takes time after an order.
strings.허브는 자전거에서 가장 빠르게, 가장 오래 도는 부품입니다. 고키소는 베: The hub is the part of a bicycle that turns fastest and longest. As a bearing maker, GOKISO started from that rotation.
strings.일반적인 허브는 림과 스포크, 프레임에서 오는 힘이 베어링에 그대로 전해: In an ordinary hub, forces from the rim, spokes and frame pass straight into the bearings. Even slight compression or tilt increases rolling resistance and shortens bearing life. GOKISO designed the body itself to act as a spring that intercepts those forces, so the bearings always turn under the same conditions.
strings.그래서 고키소 휠은 초경량을 내세우지 않습니다. 라이더와 짐의 무게 아래: That is why GOKISO wheels never chase ultra-light weight. The goals are rigidity that holds its shape under rider and load, and rotational efficiency that loses as little as possible between pedal and tire. It is also why a single hub set carries eleven bearings.
strings.아이치현에서 콘도 머신 창업. 초정밀 금형과 공작기계, 제트엔진 베어링을: Kondo Machine is founded in Aichi, making ultra-precision dies, machine tools and jet engine bearings.
strings.자체 설계와 가공 기술로 일반 시장에 내놓는 첫 제품으로 자전거 허브 브: A bicycle hub brand becomes the company's first product for the consumer market, built on its own design and machining know-how.
strings.바디 바깥에 탄성 구조를 두는 클라이머 설계가 등장하고, 티타늄 슈퍼 클: The Climber design with its elastic outer body appears, leading to the titanium Super Climber.
strings.12mm 쓰루액슬 디스크 허브와 와이드 카본 SLP 림으로 디스크 로드: 12mm through axle disc hubs and wide carbon SLP rims bring the range into the disc road era.
The GOKISO range officially imported to Korea by Rubi Company.
Ti-6Al-4V titanium body and axle. Elastic outer body with 16 fingers. Rim brake and through axle disc.
strings.A7075-T73 초초두랄루민 바디에 티타늄 액슬. 같은 탄성 구조를 더: A7075-T73 extra super duralumin body with a titanium axle. The same elastic structure, lighter. A range of matte colors.
strings.71mm, 74mm, 112mm 규격의 미니벨로 전용 허브. 슈퍼 클라이: Dedicated small wheel hubs in 71mm, 74mm and 112mm. Super Climber and Climber grades.
strings.스포크 홀을 집중 보강한 풀 카본 클린처 림에 고키소 허브를 조립한 완성: Complete wheels built on GOKISO hubs with full carbon clincher rims reinforced at every spoke hole. Wide 30 x 45mm.
The Super Climber is GOKISO's flagship hub. Body and axle are both machined whole from aerospace titanium alloy Ti-6Al-4V, and sixteen finger-like elastic elements cut around the outside of the body absorb road shock and pedaling torque. The complex, fin-like shape no other brand can replicate is not decoration. It is structure.
strings.고압 타이어와 단단한 카본 림을 쓰는 로드 레이싱에서 가볍고 단단하면서도: The goal is to stay light and rigid without losing suppleness in road racing on high-pressure tires and stiff carbon rims. It is made as a QR rim brake hub, a 12mm through axle disc hub, and in dedicated Moulton and Brompton sizes.
strings.고키소 슈퍼 클라이머 쓰루액슬 디스크 프론트 허브: GOKISO Super Climber through axle disc front hub
strings.바디와 액슬 모두 Ti-6Al-4V. CNC 절삭 후 하나씩 손으로 거울: Body and axle in Ti-6Al-4V. CNC-machined, then hand-polished one at a time to a near-mirror finish.
strings.양쪽 16개의 핑거가 베어링 하우징과 스포크 플랜지를 잇고, 외부 응력을: Sixteen fingers on each side link the bearing housing to the spoke flange and absorb external stress through elastic deformation.
strings.DIN P5 등급 일본제 비접촉 실드 베어링. 림 브레이크 세트 11개,: Japanese DIN P5 non-contact sealed bearings. Eleven per rim brake set, fourteen per through axle disc set.
strings.프레임이 변형되어도 액슬을 곧게 유지해 베어링을 보호하고 회전 정밀도를: Keeps the axle straight even when the frame deforms, protecting the bearings and their precision.
strings.티타늄 폴리시 · 림 브레이크 · 쓰루액슬 디스크 · 몰튼 · 브롬톤: Polished titanium · rim brake · through axle disc · Moulton · Brompton

strings.단위 mm, g. 센터-플랜지와 PCD는 좌 / 우. 권장 스포크 사핌: Units mm, g. Center to flange and PCD are left / right. Recommended spoke Sapim CX-Ray. Figures from the official GOKISO site and may vary by production run.
strings.클라이머(Climber)는 슈퍼 클라이머와 같은 외부 탄성체 설계를 초초: The Climber carries the Super Climber's elastic outer body design over to an extra super duralumin A7075-T73 body. The axle is still titanium Ti-6Al-4V. Fingers on both sides of the body link flange and bearing housing, and the rear body is partly thin-walled so it stays stiff under pedaling torque yet soft against impacts.
strings.림 브레이크용 S-spec은 프론트 202g, 리어 401g. 쓰루액슬: The rim brake S-spec weighs 202g front and 401g rear. The through axle disc version is built for flat mount disc road and gravel in 12 x 100 / 142mm, with Campagnolo, Shimano or SRAM XDR freehubs. Matte red and matte black are standard; small-batch colors such as brown, light grey and purple arrive from time to time.
strings.고키소 클라이머 쓰루액슬 디스크 허브 세트 매트 레드: GOKISO Climber through axle disc hub set, matte red
strings.초초두랄루민 한 덩어리를 NC 절삭. 슈퍼 클라이머와 같은 탄성 구조를: NC-machined from one block of extra super duralumin. The Super Climber's elastic structure, lighter.
strings.액슬은 Ti-6Al-4V 그대로. 구면 너트와 와셔가 클램핑 시 액슬을: The axle stays Ti-6Al-4V. Spherical nuts and washers hold it straight when clamped.
Larger-diameter single-row P5 bearings on both sides save weight. Eleven per rim set, twelve per disc set.
strings.아노다이징 매트 레드와 매트 블랙이 기본. 생산 런마다 다른 한정 컬러가: Anodized matte red and matte black as standard, with limited colors added run by run.
strings.고키소 클라이머 쓰루액슬 디스크 허브 세트 매트 브라운: GOKISO Climber through axle disc hub set, matte brown
strings.쓰루액슬 디스크 클라이머는 양쪽 14개 핑거의 탄성 바디에 12mm 쓰루: The through axle disc Climber pairs an elastic body with 14 fingers per side to a 12mm through axle. 260g front, 460g rear. The rear ratchet engages quickly with 4 pawls and 92 notches.
strings.프리허브 바디는 캄파놀로 11/12단, 시마노 11/12단, SRAM X: Choose a Campagnolo 11/12s, Shimano 11/12s or SRAM XDR 12s freehub body, swappable later. Rubi Workshop can also build it into a complete wheel on SLP rims.

strings.단위 mm, g. 센터-플랜지와 PCD는 좌 / 우. 권장 스포크 사핌: Units mm, g. Center to flange and PCD are left / right. Recommended spoke Sapim CX-Ray.
strings.슈퍼 클라이머와 클라이머가 공유하는 세 가지 구조: Three structures shared by the Super Climber and Climber
strings.플랜지와 바디를 잇는 탄성 핑거: Elastic fingers linking flange and body
strings.바디 바깥 둘레를 손가락 모양으로 깎아 스포크 플랜지와 베어링 하우징을: Finger-like elements machined around the outside of the body connect the spoke flange to the bearing housing. Forces from rim and spokes are absorbed by the fingers' elastic deformation, and the bearings turn undeformed.
strings.베어링에 힘이 닿지 않는 플로팅 구조: A floating structure that keeps loads off the bearings
strings.플랜지가 바디 셸과 분리된 플로팅 설계입니다. 노면 충격과 프레임의 뒤틀: The flanges float, separated from the body shell. Road shock and frame twist are absorbed in between, so the axle always stays straight. It is the same principle as the elastic support of a jet engine main shaft bearing.
strings.QR이나 쓰루액슬로 휠을 조일 때 프레임 엔드가 완전히 평행하지 않아도,: Even when the dropouts are not perfectly parallel as the QR or through axle is tightened, the spherical nut and washer compensate for the angle so the axle does not bend. It is the final condition for bearings that always turn in the same alignment.
strings.고키소는 처음부터 미니벨로용 허브를 따로 만들어 왔습니다. 몰튼의 71m: GOKISO has made dedicated small wheel hubs from the start. Sizes no road hub can fit, such as the Moulton's 71mm front and the Brompton's 74mm front and 112mm rear, are produced in both Super Climber and Climber grades. For the disc-braked Birdy there is a QR disc hub.
strings.작은 휠은 같은 속도에서 더 빨리 돌고, 노면의 잔진동을 더 많이 받습니: A small wheel turns faster at the same speed and picks up more road buzz. It is where GOKISO's structure, isolating the bearings from external stress, is felt most clearly. As the official Moulton importer, Rubi Workshop keeps Moulton-specific GOKISO hubs in stock and builds the wheels too.

strings.SLP는 고키소의 풀 카본 클린처 림입니다. 카본 섬유를 맨드릴에 기계로: SLP is GOKISO's full carbon clincher rim. Carbon fiber is machine-wound onto a mandrel in unbroken layers, with extra carbon laid only around the spoke holes where loads concentrate. Rigid where it must be, light everywhere else. The 30mm wide profile supports the tire broadly to cut both rolling and aerodynamic resistance, and the logo reflects light at night.
strings.루비워크샵은 30 x 45mm 디스크 림에 클라이머 또는 슈퍼 클라이머: Rubi Workshop stocks complete wheels pairing the 30 x 45mm disc rim with Climber or Super Climber through axle disc hubs. 24 holes front and rear, Sapim CX-Ray spokes. UCI certified and made in Japan.
strings.고키소 SLP 와이드 45mm 슈퍼 클라이머 디스크 휠셋: GOKISO SLP wide 45mm Super Climber disc wheelset
strings.고키소 SLP 와이드 45mm 클라이머 디스크 휠셋: GOKISO SLP wide 45mm Climber disc wheelset
strings.하중이 집중되는 스포크 홀 둘레에만 카본을 추가 적층해 강성을 높이고 전: Extra carbon only around the spoke holes where load concentrates raises stiffness and lowers overall weight.
strings.외폭 30mm 림이 28mm 이상 타이어를 자연스럽게 받칩니다. 코너에서: A 30mm external width supports 28mm and wider tires naturally. The bead hook keeps the bead seated through corners.
strings.클라이머 또는 슈퍼 클라이머 쓰루액슬 디스크 허브. 휠의 회전 효율은 허: Climber or Super Climber through axle disc hubs. A wheel's rotational efficiency is decided at the hub.
strings.림 가공과 허브 제조, 휠 조립까지 고키소 자체 공장. UCI 인증, 리: Rim machining, hub manufacturing and wheel building all in GOKISO's own factory. UCI certified, reflective logo.
strings.고키소 SLP 휠 슈퍼 클라이머 쓰루액슬 디스크 허브: GOKISO SLP wheel with Super Climber through axle disc hub
strings.SLP 림은 디스크 브레이크용으로 외폭 28~30mm에 35, 45, 6: SLP rims come in 35, 45 and 67mm depths at 28 to 30mm wide for disc brakes, and 38 and 50mm depths at 26mm wide for rim brakes. Hubs are Climber through axle disc, Super Climber through axle disc, Climber S-spec or standard.
strings.국내 기본 취급은 와이드 30 x 45mm 디스크 휠셋입니다. 다른 하이: The wide 30 x 45mm disc wheelset is the standard offering in Korea. Other depths and rim brake builds are made to order.
strings.SLP 풀 카본 클린처, 외폭 30mm x 하이트 45mm, 디스크 브레: SLP full carbon clincher, 30mm wide x 45mm deep, disc brake
strings.슈퍼 클라이머 쓰루액슬 디스크 (Ti-6Al-4V 바디 · 액슬): Super Climber through axle disc (Ti-6Al-4V body · axle)

strings.클린처용 벨로플러그 50개가 함께 제공됩니다. 튜블리스 사용은 림 테이프: 50 Velo-Plugs for clinchers are included. For tubeless use, Rubi Workshop will check rim tape and tire compatibility.
strings.고키소 허브는 주문 확정 후 일본에서 생산에 들어가며, 보통 4~6개월이: GOKISO hubs go into production in Japan once an order is confirmed, usually taking four to six months. We settle rim, spoke count and freehub body together, and Rubi Workshop builds the wheel. Moulton hubs and some models are available from Korean stock right away.
strings.허브 메인터넌스 툴, 프리바디 툴, 스페리컬 와셔, 오링 키트 같은 서비: We also import service parts and tools such as the hub maintenance tool, freebody tool, spherical washers and O-ring kits. Bearing checks and freehub swaps are done at Rubi Workshop.
